thread:
Maya: Quick design check for roles matrix — current header says "Can manage invites" and PMs flagged that "manage" is vague. Is it just invites or broader admin capabilities? Jordan: I think we should be explicit. How about 'Invite & manage seats' or 'Invites & seat management'. Sam: +1 for clarity. Keep it short though so table doesn't blow up. Priya: Accessibility note: longer headers truncate on narrow viewports and lose meaning. Whatever copy we pick needs a tooltip or accessible label. Maya: Agreed. Proposal: keep a compact header label and add a focusable tooltip that enumerates permissions (create invites, revoke invites, assign seats). Mobile: collapse to a single summary cell with a details modal. Alec: Engineering can do collapse+modal. For tooltips we need them to be in DOM (not just CSS) and have aria-describedby. Also need to maintain tab order when row action buttons exist. Priya: Tooltip must be keyboard reachable and announced. Use role="tooltip" and manage aria-hidden correctly. Contrast check too. Maya: Another ask from PM: add a quick "View audit" inline action in role cells so admins can jump to recent changes without opening member details. Any concerns with adding another inline control? Jordan: Works for me if it's unobtrusive. Show the action on hover and when the cell is focused. But hover-only won't cut it for keyboard users. Sam: Implementation pattern: action present in DOM but visually collapsed; reveal visually on hover/focus. Keeps it accessible. Example sketch: ```html Owner
View audit trail
``` Sam: Key is the link being tabbable and not just in a visually-hidden block. Might change to a visually-hidden-but-focusable helper. Priya: Wording: "View audit trail" vs "Audit log"? "View audit trail" feels more action-y and descriptive for screen readers. Also check i18n expansion. Maya: Good point. Also, table semantics: ensure role="table", aria-sort only on sortable columns, and consistent action order across breakpoints. Jordan: Related: SSO enforcement toggle needs a contextual banner that summarizes downstream effects (e.g., seat reassignments, disabled invites). Add a "Simulate impact" link that calls the backend to show estimated affected users. Alec: We can expose an API: GET /orgs/:id/sso/simulate?enforce=true that returns estimated counts and conflicts. Low-risk to prototype. Sam: I will open a ticket to add the endpoint and wire the banner to call it. UX for the banner: short sentence, bolded key number(s), and a "simulate impact" CTA. Also include a link to docs. Priya: Accessibility for the banner: role="status" or aria-live for dynamic updates after simulation. Contrasts and iconography need checks. Maya: For Friday design review bring: compact header mock + tooltip states, the inline actions visible on focus, the audit banner with simulated payload. Jordan: I'll update the Figma frames and add variants for narrow/tablet/mobile. Sam: I'll prepare a PR with the focusable tooltip and the accessible action pattern and link the backend ticket. DesignBot: New frame uploaded: https://figma.redwood/designs/roles-matrix-inline-actions (auto-upload) Maya: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
